source_gaps: Apple's Safety Check section says it can quickly stop sharing location, but the page gives no steps or labels for it, so no Safety Check steps are planned. Find My duration options are named on the page without exact labels, so only the option names are used. Android Location Sharing duration options are not listed on the page, so none are given. Excerpts and step wording come from WebFetch output (a summary), not the raw page HTML.

source_refs.title: Share your location with iPhone
source_refs.section: Stop sharing your location: Temporarily stop sharing your location with everyone
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. Open Find My. 2. Select the Me tab. 3. Turn off Share My Location. When you turn it back on, previously shared people can see your location again.

source_refs.title: Share your location with iPhone
source_refs.section: Stop sharing your location: Stop sharing with one person (Find My)
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Scroll down and tap Stop Sharing My Location. Or, under My Location, tap Hide Location to stop for the rest of the day.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. Select the People tab. 2. Choose the person. 3. Tap the More button. 4. Scroll down and tap Stop Sharing My Location. Or, under My Location, tap Hide Location to stop for the rest of the day.

source_refs.applicability: iPhone; Find My and Messages sharing
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If you delete the Find My app, people that you've shared your location with can still see your location.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: When you stop sharing your location with someone in one app, you stop sharing your location across apps. If you delete the Find My app, people that you've shared your location with can still see your location.

source_refs.title: Share your location with iPhone
source_refs.section: Start sharing your ongoing location in Find My
source_refs.verified_excerpt: In Find My, tap the Me tab and turn on Share My Location.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: 1. In Find My, tap the Me tab and turn on Share My Location. 2. Tap the People tab, tap the Add button, then tap Share My Location to add a friend and start sharing. 3. Choose to share for an hour, until the end of the day, indefinitely, or a custom time period.

source_refs.title: Share your real-time location with others in Google Maps
source_refs.section: Share your location in Google Maps
source_refs.applicability: Android phone or tablet; Google Maps app
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Important: The Location Sharing recipient must have a Gmail account.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android phone: Important: The Location Sharing recipient must have a Gmail account. 1. Open the Google Maps app. Make sure you're signed in, and that the person's Gmail address is in your Google Contacts. 2. Tap your profile picture or initial, then Location sharing, then New share (the Add people icon). 3. Choose how long you want to share your location. 4. Tap the profile of the person you want to share with. If asked about contacts, allow Google Maps access. 5. Tap Share.

source_refs.title: Share your real-time location with others in Google Maps
source_refs.section: Stop sharing your location in Google Maps
source_refs.applicability: Android phone or tablet; Google Maps app
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Tap your profile picture or initial, then Location sharing.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Android phone: 1. Open the Google Maps app. 2. Tap your profile picture or initial, then Location sharing. 3. Tap the profile of the person you no longer want to share with. 4. Tap Stop.
